tools.name: check_license
tools.description: Look up one roofing contractor license by state and license number. Returns status as published by the state regulator, a machine-readable verdict (licensed-active | licensed-not-active | not-found), licensee name, city, expiration, and provenance (regulator source URL + fetch date). tools.name: search_licensees
tools.description: Search roofing contractors by name, firm, or partial license number, optionally within a state and city. Returns up to 50 regulator-sourced records with a true total count. Use this when the user has a name but no license number.

tools.name: state_rules
tools.description: Return what Roofer Registry has verified about a state's rules for roofing contractors: licensing, licenseTypes, deductibleWaiver, depositRule, permit, insurance, unlicensedPenalty, rightToCancel, aob — each { value, quote, citation, url } or null. Plus regulator, lookup URL, active-licensee count.

tools.name: unlicensed_activity
tools.description: List people and companies the state board cited for unlicensed contracting, filtered by county and/or name. Use when the user has a name or company from a truck or flyer but no license number, or asks who was caught working unlicensed after a storm. Republished as filed; a citation is not a judgment

tools.name: enforcement_actions
tools.description: Board discipline and unlicensed-activity citations for a state, license number, name, or county. Merges licensed-activity discipline rows and unlicensed-activity citations, newest first. Republished as filed; a citation is an allegation the board acted on, a Final Order is the board's decision.

tools.name: compare_rules
tools.description: Compare a specific rule field across 2–10 states. Only states with verified: true carry a rule. Treat null as "not verified", not "no rule". Input formats: states as two-letter codes (FL, GA, TX); field is one of licensing, licenseTypes, deductibleWaiver, depositRule, permit, insurance, unlicensedPe

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: License changes (new, lapsed, status change) since a given date, optionally filtered by state and change type. Changes are tracked starting from the first roster refresh after deploy — no backfill is available. Use when monitoring for new licenses, lapses, or status changes.

tools.name: verify_live
tools.description: Fetch the current license status directly from the state regulator (FL only) and compare it with our roster copy. Uses a 24-hour cache; the second call within 24h returns cached: true. Other states return { supported: false, lookupUrl }. Hard cap: 100 live fetches per UTC day.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Send a contact request to ONE specific licensee the user has chosen, by license number. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_contact" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a contact request to ONE specific licensee the user has chosen, by license number. This creates the same consent-recorded request a person submits on the p…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_license · Private data: check_license, search_licensees, request_contact · Public sink: request_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_license · Private data: check_license, search_licensees, request_contact · Public sink: request_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
